adjudication.depicted_input: Pathology QA input consisting of a histopathology/IHC image patch and the question text/options shown above the model-response boxes.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop visibly contains two actual model inputs stated in the record: the pathology image and the question text. Under the atlas rules, a model box is not required when the figure clearly depicts the route-specific input object supplied to the model. This crop does that directly for the self-verifier image route and self-verifier question route. It does not clearly show the verifier prompt text, and it is not necessary to require explicit o4-mini branding or an inference UI.
